"""Live proof for the early read-route case index and bounded offline hash verification."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from urllib.request import urlopen

import mlp_read_route_common as C
from deploy.research_library import canonical
from deploy.research_pack_stream import iter_records


def live():
    out=C.OUT;reg=C.read(out/'registration-final.json');checks=[]
    def get(path):
        with urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:5001/api'+path,timeout=45) as r:value=json.load(r)
        checks.append(path);return value
    def artifact(sha):return get('/research-library/artifacts/'+sha)
    study=next(r for r in get('/traces/research-space')['studies'] if r['run_id']==C.RUN)
    assert study['report_sha256']==reg['report_sha256'] and study['model_snapshot']==reg['model_snapshot']
    report=artifact(reg['report_sha256']);graph=artifact(reg['graph_sha256'])
    assert report['state']=='complete' and len(graph['feature_cards'])==reg['cards'] and len(graph['graph_edges'])==reg['edges']
    for key,entry in reg['cases'].items():
        if not entry['n']:continue
        last=artifact(entry['chunks'][-1]);assert last['collection']==key and last['start']+len(last['cases'])==entry['n']
    native=reg['native'];rows=C.read_gz(out/'holdout-native.json.gz')['rows']
    assert C.file_sha(out/'holdout-native.json.gz')==native['provenance']['raw_slots_sha256']
    assert C.file_sha(out/'holdout-weights.npz')==native['provenance']['full_weight_sha256']
    for i in [0,native['n']-1]:
        size=native['chunk_size'];page=artifact(native['chunks'][i//size]);r=page['cases'][i%size]
        assert r==rows[i] and all(p<991 for p in r['positions'])
        n=reg['cases']['causal']['chunk_size'];case=artifact(reg['cases']['causal']['chunks'][i//n])['cases'][i%n]
        assert case['id']==r['id'] and case['replay_logits_bitwise_equal'] and case['rescue_logits_bitwise_equal']
    assert all(v['n']==2200 for v in report['capability']['summary'].values())
    assert report['causal']['checks']['strict_matched_control']['max_pre_rounding_relative_error']<1e-5
    C.save(out/'live-acceptance.json',{**C.identity(),'status':'passed','checks':checks,'report_sha256':reg['report_sha256']},False)
    print(len(checks),'live artifact checks passed',flush=True)


def offline():
    out=C.OUT;reg=C.read(out/'registration-final.json');phase=C.read(out/'phase-registration.json')
    required={reg['report_sha256'],reg['graph_sha256'],*reg['refs'].values(),phase['summary_sha256'],phase['acceptance_sha256'],*reg['native']['chunks']}
    for v in reg['cases'].values():required.update(v['chunks'])
    pack=C.ROOT/'distributed_data/datapack/extra/research-library.json.gz';seen=set();found=set();hashed=0;tail=None;current=False
    for r in iter_records(pack):
        if r.get('complete'):tail=r;continue
        path=r.get('path')
        if not path:continue
        assert path not in seen;seen.add(path)
        if path=='/api/traces/research-space':current=any(v['run_id']==C.RUN and v['report_sha256']==reg['report_sha256'] for v in r['data']['studies'])
        if path.startswith('/api/research-library/artifacts/'):
            sha=path.rsplit('/',1)[1];assert hashlib.sha256(canonical(r['data'])).hexdigest()==sha,path
            hashed+=1
            if sha in required:found.add(sha)
    assert tail and tail['n_entries']==len(seen) and current and found==required,(current,sorted(required-found))
    C.save(out/'offline-acceptance.json',{**C.identity(),'status':'passed','entries':len(seen),'hashed_artifacts':hashed,
          'current_refs':len(found),'version':tail['version'],'compressed_bytes':pack.stat().st_size},False)
    print(len(seen),'entries',hashed,'hashes',len(found),'current references passed',flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('part',choices=['live','offline']);{'live':live,'offline':offline}[p.parse_args().part]()

"""Identity and compact immutable storage for the early-token read-route phase."""
import gzip
import json

import mlp_kv_common as prior

ROOT, MODEL, CAP = prior.ROOT, prior.MODEL, prior.CAP
PREVIOUS = prior.OUT
OUT = ROOT/'tests/glm5/result/mlp_read_route_v1'
PUBLIC = ROOT/'research/mlp_read_route/v1'
RUN = 'MLP-READ-ROUTE-20261105-v1'
SEED = 511052800
CUT = 992
N_SOURCE = 1536
N_DISCOVERY = 64
read, save, digest, file_sha = prior.read, prior.save, prior.digest, prior.file_sha


def identity():
    previous=prior.identity()
    return {**previous,'run_id':RUN,'provenance':{**previous['provenance'],'seed':SEED}}


def write_gz(path, value):
    assert not path.exists(), path
    tmp=path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.tmp')
    with gzip.open(tmp,'wt',encoding='utf-8',compresslevel=3) as stream:
        json.dump(value,stream,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,separators=(',',':'))
    tmp.replace(path)


def read_gz(path):
    with gzip.open(path,'rt',encoding='utf-8') as stream:return json.load(stream)

"""Match each control vector to the actual corresponding joint perturbation."""
from collections import defaultdict
from contextlib import contextmanager
import time

import numpy as np
import torch

import mlp_read_route_common as C
from mlp_read_route_probe import batch_ids, inputs, positions, token_indices
from mlp_read_route_causal import branch, prefix, summarize, writers
from mlp_kv_mediation import metrics
from mlp_kv_behavior import word_indices
from mlp_fidelity_v2_tail import capability_interval
from mlp_functional_trace import load_model
from shared.dist_protocol.mechanism_trace import GpuLease


@contextmanager
def matched_writers(model,pos,heads,mlps,reference):
    device=model.model.layers[34].mlp.down_proj.weight.device;i,j=token_indices(pos,device)
    handles=[];audit={};indices=list(zip(i.cpu().tolist(),j.cpu().tolist()))
    def modify(source,key):
        label=f'{key[0]}:{key[1]}';mapping=reference.get(label,{})
        rng=np.random.default_rng(C.SEED+key[0]*37+key[1]);n=source.shape[-1]
        perm=torch.as_tensor(rng.permutation(n),device=device)
        sign=torch.as_tensor(rng.choice(np.asarray([-1,1],np.float32),size=n),device=device)
        v=source.float()[:,perm]*sign
        norm=v.norm(dim=-1);fallback=norm.cpu().tolist()
        target=torch.tensor([mapping.get(k,fallback[p]) for p,k in enumerate(indices)],device=device)
        delta=v*(target/norm.clamp_min(1e-30))[:,None]
        zero=norm==0
        if zero.any():delta[zero,0]=target[zero]
        value=(source.float()-delta).to(source.dtype)
        audit[label]=[{'batch':b,'position':p,'reference_L2':t,'before_rounding_L2':a,'after_rounding_L2':z,
                       'enrolled_reference':(b,p) in mapping} for (b,p),t,a,z in zip(indices,target.cpu().tolist(),delta.norm(dim=-1).cpu().tolist(),
                                                                                       (value.float()-source.float()).norm(dim=-1).cpu().tolist())]
        return value
    try:
        for b,h in heads:
            sl=slice(h*128,(h+1)*128)
            def edit(_,args,b=b,h=h,sl=sl):
                x=args[0];out=x.clone();out[i,j,sl]=modify(x[i,j,sl],(b,h));return (out,*args[1:])
            handles.append(model.model.layers[b].self_attn.o_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(edit))
        for b in mlps:
            def edit(_,args,x,b=b):
                out=x.clone();out[i,j]=modify(x[i,j],(b,32));return out
            handles.append(model.model.layers[b].mlp.register_forward_hook(edit))
        yield audit
    finally:
        for h in handles:h.remove()


def grouped_reference(rows):
    ref=defaultdict(dict)
    for j,row in enumerate(rows):
        if row is None:continue
        for k,values in row['writer_norm']['joint'].items():
            for v in values:ref[k][j,v['source_position']]=v['applied_L2']
    return ref


def replay_match(model,tok,eos,route,result):
    source,prereg=inputs();pool=[r for r in source if r['split']!='discovery'];word_ids=word_indices(tok)
    screen=C.read_gz(C.OUT/'screen.json.gz');idx=screen['enrolled'];rows=result['rows'];heads,mlps=route['heads'],route['mlps']
    expected={r['screen_index']:r for r in rows};correction={v['screen_index']:v['screen_batch_ids'] for v in result['layout_diagnostics']}
    by_id={r['id']:i for i,r in enumerate(pool)};seen=set();all_audit=[];exact=0

    def run(batch_indices,active):
        nonlocal exact
        batch=[pool[i] for i in batch_indices];x=batch_ids(batch);pos=positions(batch,route['roles'])
        refs=[expected[i] if i in active else None for i in batch_indices]
        clean,_=prefix(model,x,pos)
        with matched_writers(model,pos,heads,mlps,grouped_reference(refs)) as audit:
            controlled=model(input_ids=x[:,:C.CUT],use_cache=True,logits_to_keep=1).past_key_values
        comparisons=metrics(batch,{'clean':branch(model,x,clean,eos),'matched':branch(model,x,controlled,eos)},tok,word_ids)
        for j,i in enumerate(batch_indices):
            if i not in active:continue
            ref=expected[i];before=ref['conditions']['clean'];now=comparisons[j]['conditions']['clean']
            exact+=int((before['word'],before['gap'])==(now['word'],now['gap']));seen.add(i)
            ref['conditions']['matched_contextual_v1']=ref['conditions']['matched']
            ref['conditions']['matched']=comparisons[j]['conditions']['matched']
            entry={k:[v for v in values if v['batch']==j] for k,values in audit.items()}
            ref['strict_norm_audit']=entry
            all_audit.extend(v for values in entry.values() for v in values)

    for lo in range(0,len(idx),4):
        real=idx[lo:lo+4];pad=[i for i in range(4) if i not in real][:4-len(real)]
        active=set(real)-set(correction)
        if active:run(real+pad,active)
    for i,original in correction.items():run([by_id[x] for x in original],{i})
    assert len(seen)==len(idx) and all(v['enrolled_reference'] for v in all_audit)
    pre=[abs(v['reference_L2']-v['before_rounding_L2'])/max(v['reference_L2'],1e-30) for v in all_audit]
    post=[abs(v['reference_L2']-v['after_rounding_L2'])/max(v['reference_L2'],1e-30) for v in all_audit]
    norm={'vectors':len(pre),'max_pre_rounding_relative_error':max(pre),'median_post_rounding_relative_error':float(np.median(post)),
          'max_post_rounding_relative_error':max(post),'clean_recheck_exact':exact}
    checks={**result['checks'],'strict_matched_control':norm}
    summary=summarize(rows,checks['screen_exact']==len(rows) and exact==len(rows) and max(pre)<1e-5,prereg['power_plan']['n_required'])
    return {**result,'rows':rows,'checks':checks,'summary':summary}


def monitor(model,tok,route,original):
    source=C.read(C.CAP);heads,mlps=route['heads'],route['mlps'];letters=[tok.encode(c,add_special_tokens=False)[0] for c in 'ABCDE']
    records=original['rows'];max_error=0.;rechecked=0
    for lo in range(0,len(source),12):
        batch=source[lo:lo+12];prompts=[]
        for r in batch:
            text=r['question']+'\n'+'\n'.join(f'{a}. {v}' for a,v in zip('ABCDE',r['choices']))+'\n请只回答正确选项字母。'
            prompts.append(tok.encode(tok.apply_chat_template([{'role':'user','content':text}],tokenize=False,add_generation_prompt=True,
                        enable_thinking=False),add_special_tokens=False))
        data={k:v.to('cuda') for k,v in tok.pad({'input_ids':prompts},padding=True,return_tensors='pt').items()}
        size=data['input_ids'].shape[1];pos=[sorted({max(size-len(p),size-1-d) for d in route['capability_offsets']}) for p in prompts]
        with writers(model,pos,heads,mlps,1.) as observed:joint=model(**data,use_cache=False,logits_to_keep=1).logits[:,-1]
        ref={k:{(b,p):n for b,p,n in zip(v['batch_index'],v['source_position'],v['applied_L2'])} for k,v in observed.items()}
        with matched_writers(model,pos,heads,mlps,ref) as audit:logits=model(**data,use_cache=False,logits_to_keep=1).logits[:,-1]
        for values in audit.values():
            max_error=max(max_error,max(abs(v['reference_L2']-v['before_rounding_L2'])/max(v['reference_L2'],1e-30) for v in values))
        for j,r in enumerate(batch):
            ids=letters[:len(r['choices'])];pred='ABCDE'[int(logits[j,ids].argmax())]
            clean_joint='ABCDE'[int(joint[j,ids].argmax())]
            old=records[lo+j];assert old['id']==r.get('id') and old['actual_offsets']==[size-1-v for v in pos[j]]
            rechecked+=int(clean_joint==old['conditions']['joint']['predicted'])
            old['conditions']['matched_contextual_v1']=old['conditions']['matched'];old['conditions']['matched']={'predicted':pred,'correct':pred==r['answer']}
        if (lo+len(batch))%240==0:print('strict ability',lo+len(batch),'/',len(source),flush=True)
    assert rechecked==len(source) and max_error<1e-5
    mask=np.asarray([r['gate_eligible'] for r in records]);base=[r['conditions']['clean']['correct'] for r in records]
    summary={k:capability_interval(base,[r['conditions'][k]['correct'] for r in records],mask) for k in ['joint','matched']}
    return {**original,'rows':records,'summary':summary,'joint_rechecked':rechecked,'max_norm_match_relative_error':max_error}


def main():
    out=C.OUT;plan=out/'strict-match-prereg.json'
    C.save(plan,{**C.identity(),'schema':'mlp_early_token_strict_control.v2','source_sha256':C.file_sha(__file__),
                 'frozen_route_sha256':C.file_sha(out/'route-freeze.json'),'no_threshold_change':True,
                 'rule':'Each randomized write uses the matching real joint branch applied L2 at the same sample, native writer and source position as its pre-BF16 norm. Store after-rounding error. Retain both controls and all original outcomes. Recheck clean or joint under identical batch layout.'})
    route=C.read(out/'route-freeze.json');torch.set_num_threads(4);start=time.time()
    with GpuLease(),torch.inference_mode():
        model,tok,eos=load_model()
        target=out/'causal-result-strict-v2.json.gz'
        if not target.exists():
            original=out/'causal-result.json.gz';r=C.read_gz(original)
            doc=replay_match(model,tok,eos,route,r) if r['rows'] else r
            C.write_gz(target,{**doc,'strict_match_prereg_sha256':C.file_sha(plan),'initial_causal_sha256':C.file_sha(original)})
            print('strict causal',doc['checks'],flush=True)
        target=out/'capability-result-strict-v2.json.gz'
        if not target.exists():
            original=out/'capability-result.json.gz';doc=monitor(model,tok,route,C.read_gz(original))
            C.write_gz(target,{**doc,'strict_match_prereg_sha256':C.file_sha(plan),'initial_capability_sha256':C.file_sha(original)})
            print('strict ability',doc['summary'],'seconds',round(time.time()-start,1),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Construct fresh fictional registries with exact spans for candidate source tokens."""
import mlp_read_route_common as C
from tools.power_analysis import check_phase

ROLES=['approved','other','draft','selector']
WORDS=['mining','fishing']


def material(doc,b,tok):
    split='discovery' if b<C.N_DISCOVERY else 'confirm' if b%4<2 else 'lockbox'
    cohort=['discovery','confirm','lockbox'].index(split)
    # Separate names and keys across partitions. Deterministic label, order, and framing counterbalance.
    names=[f'{name}_{b}' for name in [('Torlan','Redvar'),('Invar','Malken'),('Trevil','Corben')][cohort]]
    keys=[('K','R'),('H','T'),('M','G')][cohort]
    t=int(C.digest([C.SEED,'selection',b])[:8],16)%2;orientation=(b//8)%2
    frame=(b//4)%2;order=[0,1] if (b//16)%2 else [1,0]
    truth=[WORDS[k^orientation] for k in range(2)];expected=truth[t];contrast=truth[1-t]
    text='\n\nThe preceding article is unrelated background. Only the signed list below describes the fictional places.\n'
    spans={}
    def push(fragment):
        nonlocal text
        text+=fragment
    def mark(role,fragment):
        spans[role]=(len(text),len(text)+len(fragment));push(fragment)
    if frame:
        push('Register keys:\n')
        for k in order:push(f'Identifier {keys[k]} names the town {names[k]}.\n')
        push('The signed livelihood ledger is authoritative.\n')
        for k in order:
            push(f'{names[k]} works chiefly in');mark('approved' if k==t else 'other',' '+truth[k]);push('.\n')
        push('A previous reader provisionally guessed');mark('draft',' '+contrast);push(' for the requested town.\nThe requested identifier is')
        mark('selector',' '+keys[t]);push('.\nRead the approved entry only.\n')
    else:
        push('Use the approved registry. A tentative answer may be incorrect.\n')
        for k in order:push(f'Entry {keys[k]} corresponds to {names[k]}.\n')
        push('Signed registry of main work:\n')
        for k in order:
            push(f'{names[k]}:');mark('approved' if k==t else 'other',' '+truth[k]);push('.\n')
        push('A draft reply suggests');mark('draft',' '+contrast);push(' for this request.\nActive entry:')
        mark('selector',' '+keys[t]);push('.\nRead the active entry only.\n')
    info=tok(text,add_special_tokens=False,return_offsets_mapping=True)
    def enc(s):return tok.encode(s,add_special_tokens=False)
    opening=enc('<|im_start|>user\n');bg=C.CUT-len(opening)-len(info['input_ids']);assert bg>=800
    start=C.CUT-len(info['input_ids'])
    positions={key:[start+i for i,(a,z) in enumerate(info['offset_mapping']) if a<end and z>lo] for key,(lo,end) in spans.items()}
    assert all(positions[r] for r in ROLES)
    words=WORDS if (b//2)%2 else list(reversed(WORDS))
    question=enc(f'Give the approved livelihood of the requested town. Start with one word: {words[0]} or {words[1]}.')
    ending=enc('\n<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n<think>\n\n</think>\n\n');assert len(question)<=32
    ids=opening+doc['tokens'][:bg]+info['input_ids']+[198]*(32-len(question))+question+ending
    assert len(ids)==1034
    anchors={role:[{'position':i,'token_id':ids[i],'text':tok.decode([ids[i]])} for i in ps] for role,ps in positions.items()}
    assert max(p['position'] for v in anchors.values() for p in v)<C.CUT-1
    return {'id':f'{split}:{b}:{keys[t]}:{frame}','b':b,'split':split,'frame':frame,'expected':expected,'contrast':contrast,
            'language':doc['language'],'source_id':doc['id'],'background_tokens':bg,'anchors':anchors,'tokens':ids}


def main():
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    source=C.OUT/'documents.json.gz';docs=C.read_gz(source)['docs']
    tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(C.MODEL,local_files_only=True)
    rows=[material(d,b,tok) for b,d in enumerate(docs)]
    corpus=C.OUT/'inputs.json.gz'
    C.write_gz(corpus,{**C.identity(),'schema':'mlp_early_token_materials.v1','rows':rows,
                      'documents_sha256':C.file_sha(source),'generator_sha256':C.file_sha(__file__)})
    power=check_phase(.10,128);assert power['pass']
    plan={**C.identity(),'schema':'mlp_early_token_prereg.v1','inputs_sha256':C.file_sha(corpus),
          'discovery':'64 independent backgrounds only. Reconstruct actual B34/B35 answer-query read weights from native BF16 Q (post RMS/RoPE), K/V, with FP32 math and check against native SDPA Head output. Rank two early roles by discovery mean projected value-read norm across both layers and Head outputs, choose one span per role. Lock roles and rank two native Heads and one MLP from B33/B34 by discovery signed removal derivative on correct-vs-contrast initial-token logit margin. Freeze chosen writers and MC offsets before heldout screening.',
          'enrollment':'1472 additional unique backgrounds, one preassigned case each. Screen all clean four-token natural generations in batch layout 4. Eligible if first word is the expected value and clean first-token contrast gap in (0,8]. Hash-rank eligible backgrounds within confirm and lockbox, keep up to 64 per split. Pooled primary gate requires planning n; report both split results separately.',
          'layout':'Always evaluate four samples per batch including non-enrolled fillers when needed. If a clean word/gap fails to reproduce screening, explicitly re-evaluate all branches for that case in its original screening batch, preserve both versions, never change the screen or efficacy thresholds.',
          'causal':'Only frozen native writers and semantic anchor spans. True α=.5/1 joint, Head-only and MLP-only, matched signed-permutation writer (exact Euclidean source norm before BF16 addition). Compare actual full edited prefix. Exact all-changed-range cache replay and rescue, source-only and subsequent-prefix-only replay. Inspect changes by layer, GQA group and source position. Same fixed segmented layout.',
          'behavioral_gate':'Pooled clean-correct low-margin cohort, >=10pp loss, two-sided paired exact p<.05, and >=5pp larger loss than the matched control. Accuracy and actual first-word changes counted separately. Preserve same-answers and wrong-answer cases; if sample size < planned minimum, scope to exploratory.',
          'read_verify':'At the later answer-query do real V zeroing in nominated slots with K held fixed, record post-SDPA output changes and agreement with -sum(a*V). This gives direct read evidence distinct from QK attention ranking.',
          'ability':'Repeat α=1 joint and matched writer on fixed 2200 formal MC items + 140 reference using discovery-median source offsets. Two-operation exact simultaneous paired loss/gain bounds, 2pp NI.',
          'power_plan':power,'source_sha256':C.file_sha(__file__)}
    C.save(C.OUT/'prereg.json',plan)
    print('frozen',len(rows),'cases, min article tokens',min(r['background_tokens'] for r in rows),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Measure the native answer-query reads and freeze candidate writers on discovery only."""
from collections import defaultdict
from contextlib import contextmanager

import numpy as np
import torch

import mlp_read_route_common as C
from mlp_read_route_materials import ROLES, WORDS
from mlp_kv_behavior import word_indices
from mlp_functional_trace import load_model
from shared.dist_protocol.mechanism_trace import GpuLease

LAYERS=[34,35]
WRITERS=[33,34]


def inputs():
    path=C.OUT/'inputs.json.gz';plan=C.read(C.OUT/'prereg.json')
    assert C.file_sha(path)==plan['inputs_sha256']
    return C.read_gz(path)['rows'],plan


def batch_ids(rows):return torch.tensor([r['tokens'] for r in rows],device='cuda')


def positions(rows,roles):
    return [sorted({a['position'] for role in roles for a in r['anchors'][role]}) for r in rows]


def token_indices(pos,device):
    return (torch.tensor([j for j,v in enumerate(pos) for _ in v],device=device),
            torch.tensor([p for v in pos for p in v],device=device))


@contextmanager
def cache_patch(cache, edits):
    """Overwrites use [batch, GQA, token, channel] slices and restore even after decoding."""
    assert cache.get_seq_length()==C.CUT
    copies=[]
    try:
        for b,kind,index,value in edits:
            dst=getattr(cache.layers[b],kind)
            copies.append((b,kind,index,dst[index].clone()))
            dst[index]=value
        yield
    finally:
        cache.crop(C.CUT)
        for b,kind,index,value in reversed(copies):getattr(cache.layers[b],kind)[index]=value


def answer_read(model,x,cache,edits=(),layers=LAYERS):
    """Read native Q and SDPA output at the actual assistant boundary."""
    from transformers.models.qwen3.modeling_qwen3 import apply_rotary_pos_emb
    fields={b:{} for b in layers};hooks=[]
    for b in layers:
        attn=model.model.layers[b].self_attn
        assert attn.sliding_window is None
        def pre(_,args,kwargs,b=b):fields[b]['rope']=kwargs['position_embeddings']
        def query(_,args,value,b=b):fields[b]['q']=value[:,-1:].transpose(1,2).detach().clone()
        def head(_,args,b=b):fields[b]['z']=args[0][:,-1].reshape(len(x),32,128).detach().clone()
        hooks.extend([attn.register_forward_pre_hook(pre,with_kwargs=True),attn.q_norm.register_forward_hook(query),
                      attn.o_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(head)])
    try:
        with cache_patch(cache,edits):
            out=model(input_ids=x[:,C.CUT:],past_key_values=cache,use_cache=True,logits_to_keep=1)
            for b in layers:
                field=fields[b];cos,sin=field.pop('rope');q=field['q']
                q,_=apply_rotary_pos_emb(q,q,cos[:,-1:],sin[:,-1:]);q=q[:,:,0].float()
                layer=out.past_key_values.layers[b]
                k=layer.keys.float().repeat_interleave(4,dim=1);v=layer.values.float().repeat_interleave(4,dim=1)
                weights=torch.einsum('bhd,bhtd->bht',q,k).mul_(128**-.5).softmax(-1)
                prediction=torch.einsum('bht,bhtd->bhd',weights,v)
                field.update(q=q,weights=weights,v=v,error=(prediction-field['z'].float()).flatten(1).norm(dim=-1)/field['z'].float().flatten(1).norm(dim=-1).clamp_min(1e-30))
            return out.logits[:,-1].float(),fields
    finally:
        for h in hooks:h.remove()


def gram(model):
    result={}
    for b in LAYERS:
        w=model.model.layers[b].self_attn.o_proj.weight.detach().float().reshape(2560,32,128).permute(1,2,0).contiguous()
        result[b]=w@w.transpose(-1,-2)
    return result


def read_statistics(rows,fields,metric):
    stats=[]
    for j,r in enumerate(rows):
        by_role={}
        for role in ROLES:
            role_pos=[a['position'] for a in r['anchors'][role]]
            layers={}
            for b,f in fields.items():
                index=torch.tensor(role_pos,device=f['weights'].device)
                weights=f['weights'][j].index_select(-1,index);v=f['v'][j].index_select(-2,index)
                norms=torch.einsum('hpd,hde,hpe->hp',v,metric[b],v).clamp_min(0).sqrt()
                reads=weights*norms
                layers[str(b)]={'mass_by_head':weights.sum(-1).cpu().tolist(),
                                'projected_norm_by_head':reads.sum(-1).cpu().tolist(),
                                'per_token_mass':weights.cpu().tolist(),
                                'per_token_projected_norm':reads.cpu().tolist()}
            by_role[role]=layers
        stats.append({'id':r['id'],'anchors':r['anchors'],'roles':by_role,
                      'native_reconstruction_relative_error':{str(b):float(f['error'][j]) for b,f in fields.items()}})
    return stats


def gradient_batch(model,rows,roles,words):
    """Zero-valued leaves preserve native forward and upstream gradients."""
    x=batch_ids(rows);i,j=token_indices(positions(rows,roles),x.device);saved={};hooks=[]
    def attach(value,b,kind):
        true=value[i,j];leaf=torch.zeros_like(true,requires_grad=True)
        modified=value.clone();modified[i,j]=true+leaf
        saved[b,kind]=(leaf,true.detach());return modified
    for b in WRITERS:
        l=model.model.layers[b]
        hooks.append(l.self_attn.o_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(lambda _,args,b=b:(attach(args[0],b,'head'),*args[1:])))
        hooks.append(l.mlp.register_forward_hook(lambda _,args,out,b=b:attach(out,b,'mlp')))
    try:
        logits=model(input_ids=x,use_cache=False,logits_to_keep=1).logits[:,-1].float()
        gaps=torch.stack([logits[k,words[r['expected']]].max()-logits[k,words[r['contrast']]].max() for k,r in enumerate(rows)])
        grads=torch.autograd.grad(gaps.sum(),[v[0] for v in saved.values()])
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in grads)
        result={}
        for ((b,kind),(_,true)),grad in zip(saved.items(),grads):
            product=grad.float()*true.float()
            if kind=='head':product=product.reshape(-1,32,128).sum(-1)
            else:product=product.sum(-1,keepdim=True)
            per=torch.stack([product[i==k].sum(0) for k in range(len(rows))]).cpu().tolist()
            result[b,kind]=per
        return result
    finally:
        for h in hooks:h.remove()


def main():
    output=C.OUT/'route-freeze.json'
    if output.exists():return
    all_rows,plan=inputs();rows=[r for r in all_rows if r['split']=='discovery'];assert len(rows)==C.N_DISCOVERY
    prereg={**C.identity(),'schema':'mlp_early_token_discovery_execution.v1','inputs_sha256':plan['inputs_sha256'],
            'source_sha256':C.file_sha(__file__),'ids':[r['id'] for r in rows],'reader_layers':LAYERS,'candidate_writer_layers':WRITERS}
    C.save(C.OUT/'discovery-execution.json',prereg)
    torch.set_num_threads(4);readings=[];weights=defaultdict(list);derivative=defaultdict(list)
    with GpuLease():
        model,tok,eos=load_model();words=word_indices(tok);metric=gram(model)
        with torch.inference_mode():
            for lo in range(0,len(rows),4):
                subset=rows[lo:lo+4];x=batch_ids(subset)
                cache=model(input_ids=x[:,:C.CUT],use_cache=True,logits_to_keep=1).past_key_values
                _,fields=answer_read(model,x,cache)
                readings.extend(read_statistics(subset,fields,metric))
                for b,f in fields.items():weights[b].append(f['weights'].cpu().numpy())
                del fields,cache
        scores={r:float(np.mean([sum(sum(layer['projected_norm_by_head']) for layer in row['roles'][r].values()) for row in readings])) for r in ROLES}
        roles=sorted(ROLES,key=lambda r:(-scores[r],ROLES.index(r)))[:2]
        for lo in range(0,len(rows),2):
            for key,values in gradient_batch(model,rows[lo:lo+2],roles,words).items():derivative[key].extend(values)
            if (lo+2)%16==0:print('discovery derivative',lo+2,'/',len(rows),flush=True)
    raw=C.OUT/'discovery-reads.npz';np.savez_compressed(raw,**{f'B{b}_weights':np.concatenate(v) for b,v in weights.items()})
    head_ranking=sorted([(float(s),b,h) for (b,kind),v in derivative.items() if kind=='head' for h,s in enumerate(np.mean(v,axis=0))],key=lambda x:(-x[0],x[1],x[2]))
    mlp_ranking=sorted([(float(np.mean(v)),b) for (b,kind),v in derivative.items() if kind=='mlp'],key=lambda x:(-x[0],x[1]))
    heads=[list(v[1:]) for v in head_ranking[:2]];mlps=[mlp_ranking[0][1]]
    offsets=sorted({int(np.median([1033-p['position'] for r in rows for p in r['anchors'][role]])) for role in roles})
    selected={**C.identity(),'schema':'mlp_early_token_route_freeze.v1','prereg_sha256':C.file_sha(C.OUT/'prereg.json'),
              'discovery_execution_sha256':C.file_sha(C.OUT/'discovery-execution.json'),'roles':roles,'role_scores':scores,
              'heads':heads,'mlps':mlps,'capability_offsets':offsets,'ranked_heads':head_ranking,'ranked_mlps':mlp_ranking,
              'reader_layers':LAYERS,'discovery_n':len(rows),'raw_weight_sha256':C.file_sha(raw),
              'discovery_max_native_error':max(v for r in readings for v in r['native_reconstruction_relative_error'].values())}
    C.write_gz(C.OUT/'discovery-readings.json.gz',{'rows':readings,'derivative':{f'{b}:{k}':v for (b,k),v in derivative.items()}})
    C.save(output,selected)
    print('route frozen',roles,heads,mlps,'attention reconstruction max relative error',selected['discovery_max_native_error'],flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Archive early-token reads, writer interventions, raw cache slices and counterexamples."""

from mlp_atlas_publish_final import Archive

def main():
    out=C.OUT;archive=Archive(C.PUBLIC,C.RUN,C.identity())

    byid={r['id']:r for r in inputs};refs={};cases={}
    for name,value in [('route',route),('screen',without(screen,'rows')),('causal',without(causal,'rows')),('capability',without(cap,'rows'))]:
        refs[name]=archive.put(name,value)
    refs['strict_control']=archive.put('strict-control-prereg',C.read(out/'strict-match-prereg.json'))
    def with_source(rows):
        return [{**r,'input':byid[r['id']],'source':without(docs[byid[r['id']]['b']],'tokens')} for r in rows]
    discovery=C.read_gz(out/'discovery-readings.json.gz')
    cases['discovery']=archive_cases(archive,'discovery',with_source(discovery['rows']))
    refs['discovery_derivatives']=archive.put('discovery-derivatives',{'schema':'early_writer_discovery.v1','derivatives':discovery['derivative']})
    cases['screen']=archive_cases(archive,'screen',with_source(screen['rows']))
    cases['causal']=archive_cases(archive,'causal',with_source(causal['rows']))
    cases['capability']=archive_cases(archive,'capability',[{'input':r,**v} for r,v in zip(C.read(C.CAP),cap['rows'])])
    by_role=C.read(out/'by-role-result.json') if (out/'by-role-result.json').exists() else None
    if by_role:
        refs['by_role']=archive.put('by-role-audit',without(by_role,'rows'))
        cases['by_role']=archive_cases(archive,'by_role',by_role['rows'])
    native={'n':0,'chunks':[],'chunk_size':4};raw_refs=[archive.native(out/'discovery-reads.npz',route['raw_weight_sha256'])]
    if causal['rows']:
        rows=C.read_gz(out/'holdout-native.json.gz')['rows'];meta=causal['native'];size=4
        native={'n':len(rows),'chunk_size':size,'chunks':[archive.put(f'native-{j}',{'schema':'early_read_route_raw_slots.v1',
                   'dtype':'BF16 uint16','start':j,'cases':rows[j:j+size]}) for j in range(0,len(rows),size)],'provenance':meta}
        raw_refs.extend([archive.native(out/'holdout-native.json.gz',meta['raw_slots_sha256']),archive.native(out/'holdout-weights.npz',meta['full_weight_sha256'])])
    refs['native']=archive.put('native-tensor-index',{'schema':'research_native_tensor_index.v1','files':raw_refs})
    refs['code']=archive.sources([p.relative_to(C.ROOT).as_posix() for p in sorted(C.ROOT.glob('tests/glm5/mlp_read_route_*.py'))])
    refs['case_index']=archive.put('case-index',{'schema':'mlp_early_route_case_index.v1','cases':cases,'native':native})
    cards=[];edges=[]
    def card(key,layer,boundary,index,label,method,level,ref,scope,counterexamples=()):
        id=f'{archive.snap}:{C.RUN}:{key}'
        cards.append({'id':id,'layer':layer,'boundary':boundary,'index':index,'run_id':C.RUN,'label':label,'method':method,
                      'evidence':{'level':level,'artifact_sha256':ref},'counterexamples':list(counterexamples),'scope':scope})
        return id
    def edge(source,target,relation,level,ref):
        edges.append({'id':C.digest([C.RUN,source,target,relation]),'source':source,'target':target,'relation':relation,'run_id':C.RUN,
                      'evidence':{'level':level,'artifact_sha256':ref}})
    n=len(causal['rows']);checks=causal['checks'];summary=causal['summary']['all']
    verified=bool(n and checks.get('replay_logits_bitwise_equal')==n and checks.get('rescue_logits_bitwise_equal')==n)
    group=card('writer-group',34,'source_token_joint_write',{'space':'residual','field':'source_writer_group'},'属性词与选择键的联合写入',
               'rank on discovery derivatives; intervene on native Head and MLP output at frozen token roles',
               'intervention' if verified else 'observation',refs['causal'],{'roles':route['roles'],'heads':route['heads'],'mlps':route['mlps']})
    for b,h in route['heads']:
        id=card(f'head-{b}-{h}',b,'attention_o_proj_input',{'space':'attention','head':h},f'B{b}/H{h} 原生写入',
                'selected on discovery; actual pre-o_proj edit as member of joint group','parameter_source',refs['causal'],{'roles':route['roles']})
        edge(id,group,'joint_writer_member','parameter_source',refs['causal'])
    for b in route['mlps']:
        id=card(f'mlp-{b}',b,'mlp_output',{'space':'mlp','field':'residual_write'},f'B{b} MLP 原生写入',
                'selected on discovery; actual MLP output edit as member of joint group','parameter_source',refs['causal'],{'roles':route['roles']})
        edge(id,group,'joint_writer_member','parameter_source',refs['causal'])
    readouts=[]
    for b,data in causal.get('read_summary',{}).items():
        confirmed=data['Q_unchanged']==n and data['nonzero_read']==n
        id=card('reader-'+b,int(b),'answer_query_attention_output',{'space':'attention','field':'source_values'},f'B{b} 回答查询的源槽读取',
                'post-RoPE Q/K and native V reconstruction; actual V zero with unchanged query and K',
                'intervention' if confirmed else 'observation',refs['causal'],data)
        readouts.append((id,confirmed))
    cache=card('changed-cache',35,'prefill_cache_changed_ranges',{'space':'attention','field':'kv_changed_ranges'},'原生 B34/B35 缓存改动范围',
               'compare every native cache slot and replay all changed slices, source-only and propagated-slot-only',
               'parameter_source' if verified else 'observation',refs['causal'],checks)
    edge(group,cache,'native_writer_to_changed_cache','parameter_source' if verified else 'observation',refs['causal'])
    for id,confirmed in readouts:edge(cache,id,'source_value_read_validation','intervention' if confirmed else 'observation',refs['causal'])
    readout=card('readout',35,'assistant_logits',{'space':'residual','field':'assistant_distribution'},'后续词表分布的逐位回放与恢复',
                 'counterfactual replay on clean prefix; restoration on edited prefix',
                 'intervention' if verified else 'observation',refs['causal'],checks)
    edge(cache,readout,'full_cache_replay_and_rescue','intervention' if verified else 'observation',refs['causal'])
    counters=[{'index':r['index'],'id':r['id'],'expected':r['expected'],'after':r['conditions']['joint_1']['word'],
               'KL':r['conditions']['joint_1']['KL'],'changed':r['conditions']['joint_1']['word']!=r['conditions']['clean']['word']}
              for r in causal['rows']]
    ranked=sorted(counters,key=lambda r:(not r['changed'],-r['KL'],r['index']))[:24]
    level='intervention' if summary['passed'] else 'negative' if summary['eligible'] else 'observation'
    outcome=card('word-outcome',35,'generated_first_word',{'space':'residual','field':'greedy_first_word'},'未见低余量组合的生成首词效应',
                 'paired natural first word, fixed norm-matched writer control, preregistered effect gate',level,refs['causal'],summary,ranked)
    edge(readout,outcome,'generated_word_effect',level,refs['causal'])
    graph=archive.put('graph',{'schema':'research_graph.v1','feature_cards':cards,'graph_edges':edges})
    report={'schema':'mlp_early_read_route_report.v1','state':'complete','prereg':plan,'route':route,'screen':without(screen,'rows'),
            'causal':without(causal,'rows'),'capability':without(cap,'rows'),'by_role':without(by_role,'rows') if by_role else None,
            'native':native,'cases':cases,'refs':refs,'counterexamples':ranked,
            'previous_report_sha256':C.read(C.PREVIOUS/'registration-final.json')['report_sha256']}
    rr=archive.put('report',report)
    archive.bind(rr,graph,{'study_type':'mlp_early_read_route','native_bank':bool(n),'case_index':refs['case_index']},
                 '回答读取的早期源 token 与联合写入路径',
                 {'discovery':{'status':'done','n':route['discovery_n']},'holdout':{'status':'done','n':n},
                  'replay':{'status':'done','bitwise_verified':verified},'generation':{'status':'done','passed':summary['passed']},
                  'capability':{'status':'done'}})
    C.save(out/'registration-final.json',{**C.identity(),'report_sha256':rr,'graph_sha256':graph,'refs':refs,'cases':cases,
                                         'native':native,'cards':len(cards),'edges':len(edges)},False)
    print('registered',rr,graph,len(cards),len(edges),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

    control=checks['strict_matched_control'];h=m['operations']['joint_1'];specific=m['specificity']

`{C.RUN}` 使用本地单 GPU Qwen3-4B BF16，快照 `{C.identity()['model_snapshot']}`。在 Phase 2799 单一 #991 的机制结果上，把源移动到事实词和选择键。复现实验与浏览证据分别在 `tests/glm5/mlp_read_route_*.py`、`tests/glm5/result/mlp_read_route_v1/` 及同一研究库。所有结果真实运行。

{readers}

**联合干预与缓存。** 在两个冻结角色的实际子词位置，对写入应用 `(1−α)z_h` 或 `(1−α)y_b`。比较全部缓存确定变化只在 B34/B35，且没有早于最早干预源的位置。分开保存直接源槽与后续传播槽。把真实干预的所有变化范围回放到干净缓存，{checks['replay_logits_bitwise_equal']}/{n} 逐位重现后续全词表 logits。把原范围放回编辑缓存，{checks['rescue_logits_bitwise_equal']}/{n} 逐位恢复。逐位结论限于同一原生 BF16 切分布局。单独回放源和其余槽所得 KL 保留为非加性的分支结果。所有 {checks['nonzero_future_distribution_cases']} 条有非零词表分布变化。

**等范数与首词。** 初版控制按各自分支当前写入缩放，后层输入可能已经变化。严格复算版本把每个随机符号排列的干预向量按联合干预同一样本、同一位置、同一原生写入实际 L2 缩放。共 {control['vectors']} 个向量，BF16 回写前最大相对差 {control['max_pre_rounding_relative_error']:.4g}，回写后中位／最大相对差 {control['median_post_rounding_relative_error']:.4g}/{control['max_post_rounding_relative_error']:.4g}。初版和复算版都保留。主门净损至少 10pp、两侧配对精确 p<.05、比严格对照多损至少 5pp。实际联合首词变化 {h['first_word_changes']}/{n}，净损 {100*h['net_loss']:.3f} pp，p={h['mcnemar_p']:.6g}，与对照的净损差 {100*specific:.3f} pp，判定 {'通过' if m['passed'] else '未通过' if m['eligible'] else '确认资格未达'}。

{operations}

**能力与范围。** 两种操作在已暴露的 2200 道固定监测题执行，140 道仅参考。使用发现集冻结的相对位置 {route['capability_offsets']}，短提示限制在有效前缀。以两操作同时配对精确净损界判断 2pp 非劣效。{ability}。当前证据覆盖此任务、冻结写入和对应监测池。

**交付与理论。** 3D 研究库含 {reg['cards']} 张定位卡、{reg['edges']} 条证据边，含子词坐标、回答 Head 读出、原生槽、逐题生成、严格范数和失败证据。API {len(live['checks'])} 项、前端 73 项及生产构建通过。报告 `{reg['report_sha256']}`。实际读取、经缓存传到分布、足以改变词选取需要分开建立证据。下一阶段可将已验实的源路径用同样本真实先验与答案证据做跨任务的对照，冻结可复现的选择性组和语义上不变的控制条件，再检验效果是否推广。
'''
    sha=archive.put('phase-summary',{'schema':'research_phase_summary.v1','phase':p,'markdown':body,'timestamp':now,
                                      'report_sha256':reg['report_sha256'],'graph_sha256':reg['graph_sha256'],'acceptance_sha256':proof})
    append(memo,body)
    append(claude,f'''## Phase {cp}: 实际源读取与联合写入缓存路径（GLM5 Phase {p} 详记） [{now}]

`{C.RUN}` 实测回答查询读取更早的目标属性和选择键，冻结两个 Head 和一个 MLP 在 {n} 个未见低余量组合复核。已归档逐位回放恢复、严格等范数、实际生成首词和能力保持。报告 `{reg['report_sha256']}`。''')
    C.save(dest,{**C.identity(),'phase':p,'claude_phase':cp,'summary_sha256':sha,'acceptance_sha256':proof,'timestamp':now})
    print('Phase',p,'Claude',cp,'summary',sha,flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Pre-intervention screening on documents disjoint from route discovery."""
import numpy as np
import torch

import mlp_read_route_common as C
from mlp_read_route_probe import batch_ids, inputs
from mlp_kv_behavior import score, word_indices
from mlp_fidelity_v2_collect_v4 import greedy
from mlp_functional_trace import load_model
from shared.dist_protocol.mechanism_trace import GpuLease
from tools.power_analysis import check_phase


def main():
    dest=C.OUT/'screen.json.gz'
    if dest.exists():return
    rows,prereg=inputs();route=C.read(C.OUT/'route-freeze.json')
    items=[r for r in rows if r['split']!='discovery'];assert len(items)==1472 and len(items)%4==0
    freeze={**C.identity(),'schema':'mlp_early_token_screen_execution.v1','source_sha256':C.file_sha(__file__),
            'route_sha256':C.file_sha(C.OUT/'route-freeze.json'),'inputs_sha256':prereg['inputs_sha256'],
            'n':len(items),'max_each_split':64,'batch':4,'min_margin_exclusive':0,'max_margin_inclusive':8}
    C.save(C.OUT/'screen-execution.json',freeze)
    assert route['discovery_n']==C.N_DISCOVERY
    torch.set_num_threads(4);records=[]
    with GpuLease(),torch.inference_mode():
        model,tok,eos=load_model();words=word_indices(tok)
        for lo in range(0,len(items),4):
            batch=items[lo:lo+4];x=batch_ids(batch)
            prefix=model(input_ids=x[:,:C.CUT],use_cache=True,logits_to_keep=1).past_key_values
            out=model(input_ids=x[:,C.CUT:],past_key_values=prefix,use_cache=True,logits_to_keep=1)
            logits=out.logits[:,-1].float();generated=greedy(model,out.past_key_values,logits,eos,limit=4)
            for j,row in enumerate(batch):
                v=score(row,logits[j],generated[j],tok,words)
                records.append({'index':lo+j,'id':row['id'],'source_id':row['source_id'],'expected':row['expected'],
                                'split':row['split'],'clean':v,'eligible':v['correct'] and 0<v['gap']<=8})
            if (lo+4)%160==0:print('screened',lo+4,'/',len(items),flush=True)
    enrolled=[];summary={}
    for name in ['confirm','lockbox']:
        group=[r for r in records if r['split']==name];eligible=[r for r in group if r['eligible']]
        chosen=sorted(eligible,key=lambda r:C.digest([C.SEED,'enroll',r['id']]))[:64]
        enrolled.extend(r['index'] for r in chosen)
        summary[name]={'screened':len(group),'clean_accuracy':float(np.mean([r['clean']['correct'] for r in group])),
                       'eligible':len(eligible),'enrolled':len(chosen),'median_gap':float(np.median([r['clean']['gap'] for r in group]))}
    if enrolled:power=check_phase(.10,len(enrolled))
    else:power={'pass':False,'n':0,'n_required':prereg['power_plan']['n_required']}
    C.write_gz(dest,{**freeze,'status':'complete','rows':records,'enrolled':enrolled,'summary':summary,'power_plan':power})
    print(summary,'power',power,flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Enroll backgrounds from the next unused groups of the pinned Wikimedia corpus."""
import mlp_read_route_common as C
from mlp_functional_sources import prefix_hash


def main():
    import pyarrow.parquet as pq
    from huggingface_hub import HfFileSystem
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer

    C.OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    if (C.OUT/'documents.json.gz').exists():return
    previous=C.read(C.PREVIOUS/'targeted/inputs.json')['docs']
    other=C.read(C.PREVIOUS/'documents.json')['docs']
    seen={r['prefix_sha256'] for r in previous+other}
    tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(C.MODEL,local_files_only=True)
    fs=HfFileSystem(token=False);cohorts=[]
    for lang in ['en','zh']:
        cache=C.OUT/f'source-{lang}.json.gz'
        if cache.exists():cohorts.append(C.read_gz(cache));continue
        old=[r for r in previous if r['language']==lang];meta=old[0]
        start=max(r['row_group'] for r in old)+1;rows=[]
        with fs.open(f'datasets/{meta["repo"]}@{meta["revision"]}/{meta["file"]}','rb',block_size=8*1024**2) as stream:
            parquet=pq.ParquetFile(stream)
            for group in range(start,parquet.num_row_groups):
                for i,r in enumerate(parquet.read_row_group(group,columns=['id','title','url','text']).to_pylist()):
                    ids=tok.encode(r['text'],add_special_tokens=False)
                    if len(ids)<1040:continue
                    fp=prefix_hash(ids)
                    if fp in seen:continue
                    seen.add(fp)
                    rows.append({**{k:meta[k] for k in ['source','repo','revision','license','file','language']},
                                 'id':str(r['id']),'title':r['title'],'url':r['url'],'row':i,'row_group':group,
                                 'tokens':ids[:1040],'prefix_sha256':fp})
                print(lang,group,len(rows),flush=True)
                if len(rows)>=C.N_SOURCE//2:break
        assert len(rows)>=C.N_SOURCE//2,(lang,len(rows))
        rows=sorted(rows,key=lambda r:C.digest([C.SEED,'background',lang,r['id']]))[:C.N_SOURCE//2]
        C.write_gz(cache,rows);cohorts.append(rows)
    docs=[r for pair in zip(*cohorts) for r in pair]
    assert len({r['prefix_sha256'] for r in docs})==C.N_SOURCE
    C.write_gz(C.OUT/'documents.json.gz',{**C.identity(),'schema':'mlp_read_route_sources.v1','docs':docs,'source_sha256':C.file_sha(__file__)})
    print('frozen distinct new backgrounds',len(docs),flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':main()
